person.name: Destan Guler
person.headline: Hello. I'm Destan Guler, a narrative consultant & writer bringing stories to life — on the page, on screen, and beyond.
person.intro: Destan Guler — Narrative Consultant & Writer based in Tokyo. Brand stories, screenplays, and creative collaborations.
person.aboutHeadline: I'm a storyteller, a content creator, and someone who genuinely believes the right words can change everything.
biography: Based in Tokyo, I'm a creative professional with a background in digital marketing, content production, and narrative writing. I've worked with global brands, managed campaigns that drove real results, and contributed to productions that brought stories to life on screen. Whether it's a brand narrative, a short film, or a character's dialogue — I believe every great piece of communication starts with a compelling story.

Deep down, I've always been a storyteller. It started with poems as a kid, grew into screenplays at university, and found its way onto production sets. Games, films, books, series — if there's a narrative, I'm invested. That obsession is what drives everything I do.
